item.description:
what i am looking for? something to let me see through the bullshits that the news and books and persons are piling on and to know and live my life truely. both covid and blm gave us a peek. now the control and release of epstein files just exposed a little about epstein-gang.

respiciendo prospiciendo = looking forward looking back

  • more and less:The richest man is not who has the most, but who needs the least.

  • past and future: El pasado siempre vuelve, pero nunca vuelve como lo esperamos. 过去总会重来，但从不会以我们期望的方式重来。

  • 存在即合理：黑格尔：凡是合乎理性的，终将实现为现实；凡是真正的现实，必然蕴含理性。

  • 时来天地皆同力，运去英雄不自由。– 罗隐《筹笔驿》
